people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
translations.bsb: “O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
translations.kjv: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
translations.asv: And he said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.
